summary: Bio-Path Holdings filed an 8-K announcing a shareholder update and repositioning, including cancellation of a reverse split, engagement of advisors for strategic and financial investor introductions, and board approval of a digital asset treasury 2.0 program using AI to trade and accumulate cryptocurrencies. The company also approved the assignment of up to $10M of a $57.9M judgment (plus interest) awarded to CEO Vikram Grover, to be paid in notes, preferred stock, or common shares upon monetization. No specific terms, prices, or timing are provided. This filing is not a standard M&A, tender, or restructuring event but a strategic pivot into crypto operations, warranting a special-situation classification.
